parrafo_1.es: Pro Power and Softwash atiende Boca Raton y zonas cercanas con lavado a presion y soft wash. El trabajo va desde tejas de techo tratadas con baja presion hasta entradas de concreto, caminos y adoquines de patio lavados a fondo. Alex, quien hace el trabajo en persona, es puntual y cuida cada detalle.
parrafo_1.en: Pro Power and Softwash serves Boca Raton and nearby areas with pressure washing and soft washing. The work ranges from tile roofs treated with low-pressure soft wash to concrete driveways, walkways and patio pavers washed thoroughly. Alex, who does the work himself, shows up on time and sweats the details.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes lo confirman: precios justos, trabajo mas completo de lo acordado sin cobrar extra, y un resultado que transforma la fachada de la casa.
parrafo_2.en: Their clients confirm it: fair pricing, more done than agreed with no extra charge, and a result that transforms how the house looks from the curb.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesitas limpiar: techo, entrada, patio o adoquines. Respuesta directa por telefono, sin formularios.
texto.en: Tell us what needs cleaning: roof, driveway, patio or pavers. Direct answers by phone, no forms.

texto.es: Revisamos el alcance y te damos un precio justo segun el tamaño y el estado real de la superficie.
texto.en: We look at the scope and give you a fair price based on the size and real condition of the surface.

texto.es: Soft wash de baja presion en tejas, pressure washing en concreto y adoquines. Siempre cuidando plantas y acabados.
texto.en: Low-pressure soft wash on tile roofs, full pressure washing on concrete and pavers. Always careful around plants and finishes.

texto.es: Dejamos la propiedad limpia y, como confirman nuestros clientes, a veces mas de lo acordado y sin cobrar extra.
texto.en: We leave the property clean, and as our clients confirm, sometimes with a bit more done than agreed, at no extra charge.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el alcance, escribenos.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on scope, reach out for a free estimate.

texto.es: Limpieza de baja presion que quita manchas negras, algas y suciedad de tejas sin dañarlas. El servicio que mas piden nuestros clientes.
texto.en: Low-pressure cleaning that removes black streaks, algae and grime from tile roofs without damaging them. The service our clients ask for the most.

texto.es: Concreto de entradas y caminos lavado a fondo hasta recuperar su color original.
texto.en: Concrete driveways and walkways washed thoroughly until they get their original color back.

texto.es: Adoquines alrededor de la piscina y el patio limpiados y renovados, listos para disfrutarse.
texto.en: Brick pavers around the pool and patio cleaned and refreshed, ready to enjoy again.

texto.es: Canaletas despejadas y ductos de secadora limpios, para que todo funcione como debe.
texto.en: Gutters cleared out and dryer vents cleaned, so everything runs the way it should.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un proyecto que no ves aqui? Llamanos igual, cubrimos mas de lo que parece.
pie.en: Have a project you do not see here? Call us anyway, we cover more than it looks like.

We are both very happy customers! He is very easy to work with and I will be happy to work with him again. Thank you Alex! We appreciate you so much!
